mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.alert_notification_receipt ( tenant_id, dedup_fingerprint, receiver_code, firing_delivered_at, resolved_delivered_at) SELECT tenant_id, dedup_fingerprint, #{receiver}, CASE WHEN #{notificationStatus} = 'firing' THEN current_timestamp ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{notificationStatus} = 'resolved' THEN current_timestamp ELSE NULL END FROM batch.alert_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dedup_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND alert_type = #{alertType} AND #{notificationStatus} IN ('firing', 'resolved') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, dedup_fingerprint, receiver_code) DO UPDATE SET firing_delivered_at = COALESCE(batch.alert_notification_receipt.firing_delivered_at, excluded.firing_delivered_at), resolved_delivered_at = COALESCE(excluded.resolved_delivered_at, batch.alert_notification_receipt.resolved_delivered_at), updated_at = current_timestamp
